name: Maryam · مريم
ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجۡعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وُدّٗا
en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection

name: Maryam · مريم
ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوۡمٗا لُّدّٗا
en: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people

name: Maryam · مريم
ar: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هَلۡ تُحِسُّ مِنۡهُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ أَوۡ تَسۡمَعُ لَهُمۡ رِكۡزَۢا
en: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound

name: Taha · طه
en: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed

name: Taha · طه
en: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah]

name: Taha · طه
ar: تَنزِيلٗا مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلۡعُلَى
en: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens

name: Taha · طه
en: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established

name: Taha · طه
ar: لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
en: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil

name: Taha · طه
ar: وَإِن تَجۡهَرۡ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخۡفَى
en: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden

name: Taha · طه
ar: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
en: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names

name: Taha · طه
en: And has the story of Moses reached you

name: Taha · طه
ar: إِذۡ رَءَا نَارٗا فَقَالَ لِأَهۡلِهِ ٱمۡكُثُوٓاْ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارٗا لَّعَلِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوۡ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدٗى
en: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance

name: Taha · طه
en: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses

name: Taha · طه
ar: إِنِّيٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخۡلَعۡ نَعۡلَيۡكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوٗى
en: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa
